title: cvpw cues/lyrics.timing.json
description: Lyric TIMING, deliberately separated from lyric TEXT so a project can ship one without the other (docs/SPEC.md T7). Contains no lyric words: each line carries a hash of its words, which is the copyright-safe join key against a text file the user keeps locally.

i.description: Line index. This is what `L(n)` resolves.

words.description: Optional per-word spans, for a word-level lyric layer. Present only when alignment produced them.

syllables.description: Sub-word spans, present only when a pronunciation step produced them. Inventing these for a language you cannot verify is worse than reporting word-level timing.

h.description: Hash of the line's words, lowercased with punctuation stripped. The join key: a locally-held text file is matched against this without the text ever being committed.

x.description: Hash of the exact line text, so a whitespace-only edit is distinguishable from a rewording.

manual.description: A human set or corrected this line. Tooling must not overwrite it.

note.description: What is uncertain about this line. An honest per-line note beats a confident aggregate.

notes.description: Provenance: which method produced these times, and the expected per-line error.
